Name: GetSiteProperties
Body:
{
// let siteIds=dynamic(['400000020','144710000','400000004']); //int
// let siteIds=dynamic(['400000020','100000538','100000537']); //dev
    goldAdtTwinEventsLatest
    | where TwinId in (siteIds)
    | where Action != 'Delete'
    | join kind=inner (
        goldAdtPropertyMinMaxLatestViewV2
        | where Id in (siteIds) and ModelId startswith "dtmi:qcells:site:site"
        | extend PropertyGroup = split(Key,".")[0], PropertyKey1 = split(Key,".")[1], PropertyKey2 = split(Key,".")[2]
        | extend PropertyKey = substring(Key, strlen(PropertyGroup)+1)
        | extend thebag = bag_pack(PropertyKey, iif(Key == 'commonInfo.createDate', valueMin, valueMax))
        | summarize dict = make_bag_if(thebag, array_length(bag_keys(thebag))>0), max(valueMax) by Id, ModelId, tostring(PropertyGroup)
        | project Id, ModelId, Property = PropertyGroup, ParsedValue = iff( array_length( bag_keys(dict)) == 0, max_valueMax, dict)
    ) on $left.TwinId == $right.Id
    | summarize
        twinDisplayName = anyif(tostring(ParsedValue), Property == 'twinDisplayName'),
        siteId = anyif(tostring(ParsedValue), Property == 'siteId'),
        address = anyif(todynamic(ParsedValue), Property == 'address'),
        commonInfo = anyif(todynamic(ParsedValue), Property == 'commonInfo'),
        oemInfo = anyif(todynamic(ParsedValue), Property == 'oemInfo'),
        assetRegistrationInfo = anyif(todynamic(ParsedValue), Property == 'assetRegistrationInfo'), 
        otherProperties = make_bag_if(pack(Property, ParsedValue), Property !in ('twinDisplayName', 'siteId', 'address', 'commonInfo', 'oemInfo','assetRegistrationInfo'))
    by Id
}
DocString: Fetch Site Properties for Site IDs
